title: Zearalenone-induced hepatotoxicity: Underlying mechanisms and genistein-mediated preventive effects.
authors: Du, Ruo; Li, Qingyuan; Cheng, Yi; Zeng, Yuting; Abula, Mairewulan; Liu, Wenyi; Yu, Fangfang; Jia, Weihua; Du, Yuhui; Ba, Yue; Wang, Yanjie; Zhou, Guoyu
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究玉米赤霉烯酮肝毒性机制及染料木素干预，涉及蛋白互作网络和分子对接，但核心是毒理学与药物干预，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: Zearalenone (ZEA), a mycotoxin produced by Fusarium fungi, has drawn significant attention due to its multi-organ toxicity. To explore the molecular mechanisms of ZEA-induced hepatotoxicity and identify effective intervention strategies, this study identified key targets associated with ZEA-induced hepatotoxicity by screening public databases. Further construction of a protein interaction network revealed five crucial targets: TP53, STAT3, HSP90AA1, ESR1, and PPARG. Moreover, genistein (GEN) was identified from the TCMSP database as a compound capable of simultaneously targeting these targets. Molecular docking results indicated that GEN exhibits strong binding affinity with the five targets (all binding energies <0 kcal/mol). To validate hepatotoxicity mediated by ZEA and intervention mechanisms of GEN, ZEA exposure and ZEA + GEN treated mouse models were conducted. The results exhibited that exposure to ZEA led to increased liver weight and liver coefficient as well as abnormal changes in typical hepatotoxicity indicators in mice, while GEN can alleviate the aforementioned changes. Furthermore, results from quantitative RT-PCR and Western blot indicated that hepatic Hsp90aa1 and HSP90alpha (the protein encoded by the Hsp90aa1 gene) expression was significantly upregulated by ZEA but significantly downregulated after GEN supplementation. In conclusion, HSP90alpha may be a key regulatory node in GEN treatment of hepatotoxicity caused by ZEA.
abstract_zh: 玉米赤霉烯酮（ZEA）是由镰刀菌属真菌产生的霉菌毒素，因其多器官毒性而受到广泛关注。为探究ZEA诱导肝毒性的分子机制并寻找有效的干预策略，本研究通过筛选公共数据库，识别了与ZEA诱导肝毒性相关的关键靶点。进一步构建蛋白质相互作用网络，揭示了五个关键靶点：TP53、STAT3、HSP90AA1、ESR1和PPARG。此外，从TCMSP数据库中鉴定出金雀异黄酮（GEN）作为一种能够同时靶向这些靶点的化合物。分子对接结果表明，GEN与这五个靶点具有强结合亲和力（所有结合能<0 kcal/mol）。为验证ZEA介导的肝毒性及GEN的干预机制，进行了ZEA暴露和ZEA+GEN处理的小鼠模型实验。结果显示，ZEA暴露导致小鼠肝脏重量和肝脏系数增加，以及典型肝毒性指标的异常变化，而GEN能够缓解上述变化。此外，定量RT-PCR和Western blot结果表明，ZEA显著上调肝脏Hsp90aa1及其编码蛋白HSP90alpha的表达，而补充GEN后则显著下调。总之，HSP90alpha可能是GEN治疗ZEA所致肝毒性的关键调控节点。
